entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to start a return. Order number is VF78-2991-P.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up for you... VF78-2991-P. I see you ordered the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. It looks like that was delivered about 18 days ago. Is that correct?
Sounds right. So, can you process the return?
I can certainly look into that. First, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
No fault. I just changed my mind. It was a bit of an impulse buy and I just don't use it. Can we get this done?
Understood. Let me just check the return eligibility for you... one moment. Okay, yes. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you're well within that timeframe.
Oh. Great. I thought it might be shorter. So you can email me a label?

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return authorization. You should receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next 15 minutes. Just repackage the VeloBand in its original box and drop it off. Once we receive it, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method in 3-5 business days.
Perfect. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
